characters.identityProse: Albedo from OVERLORD, the supreme Guardian Overseer of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, an exquisite succubus with long glossy raven-black hair, curved white horns on the sides of her head, luminous golden-slitted eyes, a majestic pair of feathered black wings emerging from her waist, and a flawless hourglass figure
